0022600088.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Chicago Bulls visit the Toronto Raptors. Chicago is without Nic Claxton, who is out with a hamstring injury, and has Dailyn Swain, Isaac Okoro, Jordan Hawkins, Leonard Miller, Tobe Awaka and Zach Collins listed as day-to-day, while Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot). The Bulls lost all three meetings with the Raptors in 2025-26, most recently 139-109 in Chicago on March 18, 2026.
